Manish Brahmbhatt launches CJP-D, challenging Abhijeet Dipke

On Thursday, Manish Brahmbhatt announced the formation of the Cockroach Janata Party‑Democratic (CJP‑D), a splinter from the original Cockroach Janata Party, and issued a challenge to party leader Abhijeet Dipke. The launch follows an internal dispute within the original party. Brahmbhatt is reported to have connections to Gujarat. Dipke has publicly criticised the BJP, denied being a "B‑team" member, and faced questions about his academic degree. The new CJP‑D is presented as a separate political platform.
